fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable camera preset name (e.g. 'Right shoulder', 'Left shoulder', 'Wide').

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier for this camera preset.

fields.name: shoulderOffset
fields.title: Shoulder offset (m)
fields.description: Lateral over-the-shoulder camera offset. Positive = right shoulder, negative = left. Source camera_rig.gd SHOULDER_OFFSET / FRAME_OFFSET_* (±0.6).

fields.name: distance
fields.title: Chase distance (m)
fields.description: Base third-person chase distance (spring length). Source camera_rig.gd DISTANCE_THIRD_PERSON (3.0) / FRAME_DISTANCE_WIDE (4.5).

fields.name: fov
fields.title: FOV (deg)
fields.description: Base hip/traversal field of view in degrees. Source camera_rig.gd FOV_BASE (75).

fields.name: sensitivityMult
fields.title: Sensitivity multiplier
fields.description: User look-sensitivity multiplier applied to both mouse and stick deltas. Source camera_rig.gd _sens_scale default (1.0), clamped [0.25, 2.5].

fields.name: stances
fields.title: Stances
fields.description: Framing stances this preset cycles through (the E-key over-shoulder framing cycle). Each carries an additive FOV delta and an override chase distance.

fields.name: stance
fields.title: Stance
fields.description: Which over-shoulder framing this stance represents. Source camera_rig.gd framing-cycle presets (all TPS chase, never first-person).

fields.name: fovDelta
fields.title: FOV delta (deg)
fields.description: Additive FOV change for this stance vs the preset's base FOV.

fields.name: distance
fields.title: Chase distance (m)
fields.description: Chase distance for this stance. RIGHT/LEFT 3.0, WIDE 4.5.
